entries.title: Floating Staircase Logic Machine
entries.description: A spiral staircase made of semi-transparent blocks floats in midair, where each step that is touched detaches, rotates slowly, reattaches in a different place, and changes color while glowing arrows and labels show the “logical path” constantly rewiring itself.

entries.title: Colliding Thought Bubbles
entries.description: Colorful transparent spheres labeled with short words drift in 3D space, collide gently to merge into new larger bubbles with blended colors and combined labels, then split back into smaller bubbles that leave fading trails.
